director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?
samajh nahi aaya
Aaj hum dekhenge ki alag numbers wale fraction bhi barabar ho sakte hain. Toh shuru karte hain?
pata nahi
Achha, pehle main dikhati hoon. Roti aadhi modi, ek aadhe par ghee lagaya. Kaagaz ki patti par yahi: beech se modi, toh 2 barabar hisse; rang wala hissa patti ka 1/2 hai. Yahan tak saaf hai?
nahi

Ek roti do bachche barabar baantein, toh har ek ko aadhi roti milti hai. Is patti ka rang wala hissa bhi waisa hi hai: do barabar mein se ek. Doosri patti bilkul utni hi lambi hai, par 10 barabar hisson mein kati hai. Pehli patti ka rang wala aadha, doosri patti ke kitne hisson jitna hai?
director.card: Doosri patti bilkul utni hi lambi hai, par 10 barabar hisson mein kati hai. Pehli patti ka rang wala aadha, doosri patti ke kitne hisson jitna hai?

director.text: pata nahi

Pehli patti ke rang wale hisse ke theek neeche dekho, aur doosri patti ke jo hisse wahan tak aate hain, unhe gino. Pehli patti ka rang wala aadha, 10 hisson wali doosri patti ke kitne hisson jitna hai?
director.card: Doosri patti bilkul utni hi lambi hai, par 10 barabar hisson mein kati hai. Pehli patti ka rang wala aadha, doosri patti ke kitne hisson jitna hai?

director.text: hindi mein batao na

director.card: 10 chhote hisson wali patti mein, aadhi patti kitne hisson ki hogi?

seams.form: Achha, ab Hindi mein bolti hoon.

Patti ko beech se moda, toh do barabar hisse bane. Rang ek hisse mein hai, isliye rang aadhi patti par hai. Pehli patti ka rang wala aadha, 10 hisson wali doosri patti ke kitne hisson jitna hai?
director.card: Doosri patti bilkul utni hi lambi hai, par 10 barabar hisson mein kati hai. Pehli patti ka rang wala aadha, doosri patti ke kitne hisson jitna hai?

director.text: 5 hisson jitna

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki 10 hisson ka aadha 5 hisse hai. Ab wahi patti ek baar aur modi, toh 4 barabar hisse bane. Rang wala aadha ab 2 hisson mein hai, yaani 2/4; rang utna hi raha, isliye 1/2 = 2/4. Nayi patti utni hi lambi hai, par 12 barabar hisson mein kati hai. Ismein kitne hisson mein rang bharen ki rang pehli patti jitna hi ho?
director.card: Nayi patti utni hi lambi hai, par 12 barabar hisson mein kati hai. Ismein kitne hisson mein rang bharen ki rang pehli patti jitna hi ho?

director.text: chhe

Sahi jawab. 4 × 3 = 12, toh rang wale 2 × 3 = 6. Yeh number line 0 se 1 tak 8 barabar gap mein kati hai. Beech ka mark 4/8 hai, aur wahi 1/2 bhi hai aur 2/4 bhi. Toh 1/2 = 2/4 = 4/8: ek jagah, teen naam. Isi line par 0 se chalkar 3/4 tak pahunchna hai. 1/8 wale kitne gap chalne honge?
director.card: Isi line par 0 se chalkar 3/4 tak pahunchna hai. 1/8 wale kitne gap chalne honge?

director.text: drawing karke samjhao
Yahan line ek patti ban gayi hai: aath barabar hisse, aur pehle aadhe hisson mein rang, theek beech tak. 0 se 3/4 tak pahunchne ke liye, is line par 1/8 wale kitne gap chalne honge?
director.card: Isi line par 0 se chalkar 3/4 tak pahunchna hai. 1/8 wale kitne gap chalne honge?

picture.line: Yahan line ek patti ban gayi hai: aath barabar hisse, aur pehle aadhe hisson mein rang, theek beech tak.

director.text: 3 sahi nahi hai. Is line par 3/4 tak 3 gap nahi hain: har gap 1/8 hai, jo 1/4 se chhota hai, isliye 3/4 tak 3 se zyada gap lagenge. Ab tum batao.
director.card: Isi line par 0 se chalkar 3/4 tak pahunchna hai. 1/8 wale kitne gap chalne honge?

director.text: chhah

Haan, sahi hai: line par har 1/4 mein 1/8 wale 2 gap hain, toh 3/4 tak 3 × 2 = 6 gap, yaani 6/8. Aao, yeh sawaal main aur tum saath mein karenge. Sana ek rumal ko aadha modti hai aur ek aadhe mein rang bharti hai. Phir use do baar aur aadha modti hai. Teeno mod ke baad rumal kholo, toh kul kitne barabar hisse dikhenge?

seams.form: Aao, yeh sawaal main aur tum saath mein karenge.

director.text: mujhe nahi pata
Kaagaz ko ek baar modkar kholo, aur dekho ki pehle ka ek hissa ab kitne hisson mein bata hai. Ek rumal ko teen baar, har baar aadha moda; kholne par kul kitne barabar hisse dikhenge?
mujhe nahi pata

Har mod par har hissa do mein bant-ta hai, isliye hisse har baar dugne hote hain, aur teen mod ke baad 8 ho jaate hain. Rumal ke 8 barabar hisse hain, toh har chhota hissa poore rumal ka 1/8 hai. Kholne par 8 hisson mein se kitne hisson mein rang dikhega?
director.card: Kholne par 8 hisson mein se kitne hisson mein rang dikhega?

director.text: mujhe khud try karne do
Haan, pehle tum try karo.
director.card: Kholne par 8 hisson mein se kitne hisson mein rang dikhega?

director.text: 8 sahi nahi hai. Kholne par rumal ke kul hisse 8 hain. Par rang modne se phailta nahi: woh sirf usi aadhe ke chhote hisson par rehta hai jismein pehle bhara tha. Kholne par rumal ke 8 hisson mein se kitne hisson mein rang hoga?
director.card: Kholne par 8 hisson mein se kitne hisson mein rang dikhega?

director.text: Nahi, 8 theek nahi. Pehle mod ke baad rang ek aadhe mein tha. Agle do mod ne us rang wale aadhe ko bhi kaata; socho woh kitne hisson mein bata. Ab phir se socho, jawab kya hoga?
director.card: Kholne par 8 hisson mein se kitne hisson mein rang dikhega?

director.text: four

Haan, bilkul theek. Toh poora jawab: kholne par 8 barabar hisse hain aur 4 mein rang, yaani 4/8, jo 1/2 ke barabar hai, kyunki hisse badle, par rumal par rang utna hi raha. Chalo, ab tumhari apni baari. Do ek jaisi chocolate hain. Mohit ne ek chocolate ka 1/2 khaya. Anjali ne doosri ke 6 barabar hisson mein se 3 khaaye. Zyada kisne khaya: Mohit ne, Anjali ne, ya dono ne barabar khaya?

director.text: Anjali

Yeh jawab sahi nahi hai. Ise alag tareeke se dekhte hain. Dono patti ek jitni lambi hain, pehli 2 hisson mein aur doosri 4 mein. Doosri ke hisse chhote hain: uske 2 hisse pehli ke ek hisse jitne hain. Farhan ne chocolate ka 1/3 khaya; Zoya ne waisi chocolate ke 6 barabar hisson mein se 2. Kiska zyada, ya barabar?

Abhi yeh sahi nahi hai. Hisse zyada hone se chocolate zyada nahi hoti: chocolate jitne zyada hisson mein kate, har hissa utna chhota. Ek bade hisse ke barabar kitne chhote hisse hain, woh socho. Farhan ke 1/3 aur Zoya ke 6 mein se 2 hisson mein, zyada kisne khaya, ya barabar?

Nahi, yeh theek nahi hai. Chocolate ke 6 hisson ke teen barabar dher socho, aur dekho ki ek dher mein kitne hisse aate hain. Apna jawab tum khud bolo.

Yeh jawab sahi nahi hai. Board par ungli rakho: neeche wali patti ke hisse gino, jab tak upar wali patti ka pehla hissa khatam na ho. Farhan ke 1/3 aur Zoya ke 6 mein se 2 hisson mein, zyada kisne khaya, ya barabar?

director.text: dono ne barabar khaya

Haan, bilkul theek. 2/6 = 1/3 hai: 6 wale do chhote hisse milkar 3 wala ek hissa banate hain, isliye dono ne barabar khaya. Ab us sawaal par lautte hain jo humne pehle chhoda tha. director.text: barabar

Sahi jawab, kyunki 6 barabar hisson mein se 3 hisse 3/6 hain, aur 3/6 = 1/2, isliye dono ne barabar khaya. Yeh number line 0 se 1 tak 12 barabar gap mein kati hai. Is line par 5/12, 1/2 se bada hai, chhota hai, ya barabar?
director.card: Yeh number line 0 se 1 tak 12 barabar gap mein kati hai. Is line par 5/12, 1/2 se bada hai, chhota hai, ya barabar?

director.text: smaller hai na

Haan, sahi hai. 5/12 is line par paanchve mark par hai, aur 1/2 = 6/12 chhatthe mark par, isliye 5/12 chhota hai. Modne par 1/2 se 2/4 bana: kul hisse aur rang wale hisse, dono dugne hue, aur rang utna hi raha. Ab bina mode, guna karke barabar fraction banayenge. Yahan tak saaf hai?
aapko virat pasand hai?
Main AI teacher hoon, isliye meri apni koi pasand nahi hoti. Tumhe Virat ke baare mein sabse achha kya lagta hai?
sixer

Wah, sixer! Toh tumhara favourite yahi hai. Chalo, jahan the wahin se aage chalte hain. Is patti ke 5 barabar hisse hain aur 2 mein rang, yaani 2/5. Neeche ka 5 saare hisse ginta hai, aur upar ka 2 rang wale. Ab tak samajh aaya?

seams.form: Chalo, jahan the wahin se aage chalte hain.

j2.line: Wah, sixer! Toh tumhara favourite yahi hai.

director.text: samajh nahi aaya

Fraction ko do baaton ki tarah suno: neeche wala 5 kehta hai ki poore ke 5 barabar hisse hain, aur upar wala 2 kehta hai ki unmein se 2 lo. Nayi patti utni hi lambi hai, par har hissa 2 chhote hisson mein kata hai. Pehli patti ke rang wale 2 hisse, nayi patti mein kitne chhote hisse bante hain?
director.card: Nayi patti utni hi lambi hai, par har hissa 2 chhote hisson mein kata hai. Pehli patti ke rang wale 2 hisse, nayi patti mein kitne chhote hisse bante hain?

director.text: phir bhi samajh nahi aaya
Pehli patti ke ek rang wale hisse ke neeche nayi patti ke hisse gino, phir doosre rang wale hisse ke neeche bhi. Pehli patti ke rang wale 2 hisse, nayi patti ke kitne chhote hisse bante hain?
director.card: Nayi patti utni hi lambi hai, par har hissa 2 chhote hisson mein kata hai. Pehli patti ke rang wale 2 hisse, nayi patti mein kitne chhote hisse bante hain?

director.text: chaar

Haan, bilkul theek: har rang wala hissa 2 bana, toh 4. Is patti mein rang 4/10 hai, aur yahi 2/5 bhi hai. Neeche 5 × 2 = 10 aur upar 2 × 2 = 4: dono ek hi number se guna hue. Ab 5/6 ke upar aur neeche, dono ko 2 se guna karo. Kaunsa barabar fraction banega?
director.card: Ab 5/6 ke upar aur neeche, dono ko 2 se guna karo. Kaunsa barabar fraction banega?

director.text: 10/6 sahi nahi hai. Ek aur raasta aazmaate hain. Patti ka har hissa 2 mein kaato, toh kul hisse bhi dugne hote hain aur rang wale hisse bhi. Isliye upar aur neeche, dono number 2 se guna hote hain, koi ek nahi. 1/6 ke barabar fraction mein neeche 12 likha hai. Upar ka number kitna hoga?
director.card: 1/6 ke barabar fraction mein neeche 12 likha hai. Upar ka number kitna hoga?

director.text: Nahi, 1 theek nahi. 12 hisson wali patti ka ek hissa, 6 hisson wali patti ke ek hisse se chhota hai. Isliye upar 1 hi rakhne se rang kam ho jaata hai. Neeche 12 ho, toh 1/6 ke barabar fraction ka upar wala number kya aayega?
director.card: 1/6 ke barabar fraction mein neeche 12 likha hai. Upar ka number kitna hoga?

director.text: 1 se baat nahi bani. Pehle dekho ki 1/6 ka neeche wala number kis number se guna hokar 12 banta hai. Phir upar wale ko bhi usi se guna karo. Ab tumhari baat sunti hoon.
director.card: 1/6 ke barabar fraction mein neeche 12 likha hai. Upar ka number kitna hoga?

director.text: upar 2

Sahi jawab, kyunki neeche 6 × 2 = 12, toh upar bhi 1 × 2 = 2, yaani 2/12. Achha, ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain. Ab 5/6 ke upar aur neeche, dono ko 2 se guna karo. Kaunsa barabar fraction banega?
director.card: Ab 5/6 ke upar aur neeche, dono ko 2 se guna karo. Kaunsa barabar fraction banega?

seams.form: Achha, ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain.

director.text: 10 bata 12

Haan, bilkul theek. Hisse 6 se 12, toh rang wale 5 se 10. Kuch bachche 1/2 ke upar-neeche 1 jodkar 2/3 likhte hain; number line par 1/2 aur 2/3 alag jagah hain. Isi line par 1/3, 0 ke baad doosre mark par hai. 1/3 ke upar aur neeche 1 jodo, toh 2/4 banta hai. 2/4 is line par 0 ke baad kaunse mark par aayega?
director.card: Isi line par 1/3, 0 ke baad doosre mark par hai. 1/3 ke upar aur neeche 1 jodo, toh 2/4 banta hai. 2/4 is line par 0 ke baad kaunse mark par aayega?

director.text: 2 sahi nahi hai. Isko doosri tarah se samajhte hain. Upar-neeche ek hi number jodne se barabar fraction nahi banta. 4 hisson se 8 banane ke liye har hissa 2 mein kaata, toh rang wala 1 hissa bhi 2 bana: dono 2 se guna hue. 2/3 ke barabar ek fraction ka neeche 6 hai. Uska upar kya aayega?
director.card: 2/3 ke barabar ek fraction ka neeche 6 hai. Uska upar kya aayega?

seams.form: Isko doosri tarah se samajhte hain.

director.text: Nahi, 5 theek nahi. 5/6 mein sirf ek chhota hissa khaali hai, par 2/3 mein ek bada hissa khaali hai. Isliye upar 3 jodne se rang badh gaya. 2/3 ke barabar, neeche 6 wale fraction ka upar wala number kya aayega?
director.card: 2/3 ke barabar ek fraction ka neeche 6 hai. Uska upar kya aayega?

director.text: 5 se baat nahi bani. 2/3 ke hisson se 6 hisse banane ke liye har hissa kaise kaatna padega, aur tab rang wale hisson ka kya hoga, yeh socho. Ab tum batao.
director.card: 2/3 ke barabar ek fraction ka neeche 6 hai. Uska upar kya aayega?

director.text: upar 4

Sahi jawab, kyunki 2/3 ke upar-neeche dono ko 2 se guna kiya: 2 × 2 = 4 aur 3 × 2 = 6, yaani 4/6. Chalo, pehle wale sawaal ki taraf wapas aate hain. Isi line par 1/3, 0 ke baad doosre mark par hai. 1/3 ke upar aur neeche 1 jodo, toh 2/4 banta hai. 2/4 is line par 0 ke baad kaunse mark par aayega?
director.card: Isi line par 1/3, 0 ke baad doosre mark par hai. 1/3 ke upar aur neeche 1 jodo, toh 2/4 banta hai. 2/4 is line par 0 ke baad kaunse mark par aayega?

seams.form: Chalo, pehle wale sawaal ki taraf wapas aate hain.

director.text: Haan, bilkul theek: 2/4 = 1/2 = 3/6, yaani 0 ke baad 3 gap; 1/3 sirf 2 gap par hai. Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum saath mein karte hain. Neha ko 3/5 ke barabar do fraction likhne hain: ek jiska neeche wala number 10 ho, aur ek jiska 15. Neeche 5 se 10 bana. Upar ke 3 ke saath kya karoge?

seams.form: Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum saath mein karte hain.

director.text: bas aaj ke liye itna hi
Theek hai, koi baat nahi. Hum aage chal sakte hain, thoda break le sakte hain, ya aaj ke liye stop kar sakte hain. Tum batao.
